title: Health & Training
description: Huawei watch data via Gadgetbridge and the gym app's logged workouts: recovery against your own baseline, sleep, activity with wear-time gaps, training load and lifts.

panels.title: Recovery
panels.description: HRV 7-day average vs your normal range (60 days before), resting HR vs its 30-day average, and last night's sleep. Good / Normal = train as planned; Take it easier = go lighter; Rest = resting HR up two days running with low HRV. Guidance from a wrist sensor, not a diagnosis.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, readiness_score AS "Recovery" FROM days WHERE readiness_score IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, readiness_score AS "Recovery" FROM days WHERE readiness_score IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last night's sleep
panels.description: Hours asleep in the main sleep that ended that morning. Nights under 3 h of recorded sleep don't count.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, sleep_h AS "Sleep" FROM days WHERE sleep_h IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, sleep_h AS "Sleep" FROM days WHERE sleep_h IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.queryText: SELECT time, rhr AS "Resting HR" FROM days WHERE rhr IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, rhr AS "Resting HR" FROM days WHERE rhr IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.queryText: SELECT time, rhr_base AS "Usual" FROM days WHERE rhr_base IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, rhr_base AS "Usual" FROM days WHERE rhr_base IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.queryText: SELECT time, hrv7 AS "HRV 7-day" FROM days WHERE hrv7 IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, hrv7 AS "HRV 7-day" FROM days WHERE hrv7 IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Active minutes this week
panels.description: Moderate (64-76% of max HR) plus vigorous (77%+) x 2, Monday to now. WHO: 150-300 a week.

targets.queryText: SELECT max(time) AS time, sum(coalesce(mod_min, 0) + 2 * coalesce(vig_min, 0)) AS "WHO minutes" FROM days WHERE time >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now', '+330 minutes', 'weekday 0', '-6 days')) AS INTEGER) - 19800
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT max(time) AS time, sum(coalesce(mod_min, 0) + 2 * coalesce(vig_min, 0)) AS "WHO minutes" FROM days WHERE time >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now', '+330 minutes', 'weekday 0', '-6 days')) AS INTEGER) - 19800

panels.title: Data updated
panels.description: When the gym app last rewrote health.db (a minute after new data, and every 15 min).

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS "Updated" FROM meta WHERE key = 'updated_at'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS "Updated" FROM meta WHERE key = 'updated_at'

panels.title: Resting heart rate
panels.description: Drifting down over months = fitter. 5+ above usual for a few days often means poor sleep, stress or illness.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, rhr AS "Resting HR", rhr_base AS "Usual (30-day)" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, rhr AS "Resting HR", rhr_base AS "Usual (30-day)" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: HRV (rMSSD)
panels.description: Your normal range is the mean +/- half a standard deviation of ln(rMSSD) over the 60 days before. A 7-day average below it means recover more.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, hrv AS "Each night", hrv7 AS "7-day average", hrv_lo AS "Normal low", hrv_hi AS "Normal high" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, hrv AS "Each night", hrv7 AS "7-day average", hrv_lo AS "Normal low", hrv_hi AS "Normal high" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT time, readiness_score AS "Recovery" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, readiness_score AS "Recovery" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sleep stages per night
panels.description: Credited to the morning you woke up. Nights without the watch are blank. Line = 7 h.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, deep_h AS "Deep", light_h AS "Light", rem_h AS "REM", awake_h AS "Awake" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, deep_h AS "Deep", light_h AS "Light", rem_h AS "REM", awake_h AS "Awake" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT date AS Night, sleep_h AS Asleep, substr(time(bedtime + 19800, 'unixepoch'), 1, 5) AS Bed, substr(time(waketime + 19800, 'unixepoch'), 1, 5) AS Wake, round(100.0 * deep_h / sleep_h) AS "Deep %", round(100.0 * rem_h / sleep_h) AS "REM %", hrv AS HRV, spo2_min AS "SpO2 low" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 AND sleep_h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT date AS Night, sleep_h AS Asleep, substr(time(bedtime + 19800, 'unixepoch'), 1, 5) AS Bed, substr(time(waketime + 19800, 'unixepoch'), 1, 5) AS Wake, round(100.0 * deep_h / sleep_h) AS "Deep %", round(100.0 * rem_h / sleep_h) AS "REM %", hrv AS HRV, spo2_min AS "SpO2 low" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 AND sleep_h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC

panels.title: Steps per day
panels.description: A day counts only with 10+ hours worn between 7:00 and 23:00; partial days are grey and left out of averages. Line = 8,000.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, steps_valid AS "Full day", steps_partial AS "Partial day (not averaged)" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, steps_valid AS "Full day", steps_partial AS "Partial day (not averaged)" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Hours worn per day
panels.description: A 15-minute slot counts as worn if it has a heart-rate reading or steps.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, wear_h AS "Worn (24 h)", wake_wear_h AS "Worn 7:00-23:00" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, wear_h AS "Worn (24 h)", wake_wear_h AS "Worn 7:00-23:00" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Heart rate (last 2 days)
panels.description: Per minute. Gaps are the times the watch was off your wrist.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, bpm AS "Heart rate" FROM hr WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, bpm AS "Heart rate" FROM hr WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active minutes per week
panels.description: Moderate + vigorous x 2, from heart rate. Line = 150 (WHO minimum).

targets.queryText: SELECT time, activity_min AS "WHO minutes" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, activity_min AS "WHO minutes" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Days trained per week
panels.description: Lifting sessions and Cult classes. Line = the 5-day weekly goal.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, days_trained AS "Days trained" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, days_trained AS "Days trained" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Hard sets per week
panels.description: Ticked working sets in the gym app.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, hard_sets AS "Hard sets" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, hard_sets AS "Hard sets" FROM weeks WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Heart-rate load per day (TRIMP)
panels.description: Edwards' TRIMP: minutes in heart-rate zones 1-5 weighted 1-5. Lifting reads low on heart rate.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, trimp AS "Load" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, trimp AS "Load" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Main lifts: estimated 1-rep max
panels.description: Epley estimate from the best set of each session.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Barbell Bench Press' THEN e1rm END) AS "Bench press", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Barbell Back Squat' THEN e1rm END) AS "Back squat", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Romanian Deadlift (RDL)' THEN e1rm END) AS "Romanian deadlift", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Lat Pulldown' THEN e1rm END) AS "Lat pulldown" FROM lifts WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Barbell Bench Press' THEN e1rm END) AS "Bench press", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Barbell Back Squat' THEN e1rm END) AS "Back squat", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Romanian Deadlift (RDL)' THEN e1rm END) AS "Romanian deadlift", max(CASE WHEN exercise = 'Lat Pulldown' THEN e1rm END) AS "Lat pulldown" FROM lifts WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Workouts
panels.description: Watch-recorded and logged sessions, merged when they overlap. Z1-Z5: minutes in each zone.

targets.queryText: SELECT date AS Date, coalesce(name, type) AS Workout, minutes AS Min, avg_hr AS "Avg HR", max_hr AS "Max HR", trimp AS Load, z1 AS Z1, z2 AS Z2, z3 AS Z3, z4 AS Z4, z5 AS Z5 FROM workouts WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT date AS Date, coalesce(name, type) AS Workout, minutes AS Min, avg_hr AS "Avg HR", max_hr AS "Max HR", trimp AS Load, z1 AS Z1, z2 AS Z2, z3 AS Z3, z4 AS Z4, z5 AS Z5 FROM workouts WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time DESC

panels.title: Weight
panels.description: In a recomp the scale can sit still while you lose fat and gain muscle; watch the trend with your lifts.

targets.queryText: SELECT time, weight AS "Weigh-in", weight7 AS "7-day average" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, weight AS "Weigh-in", weight7 AS "7-day average" FROM days WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time <= $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time
